title: OPERA Displacement Daily
description: OPERA displacement products including azimuth offset, range offset, unwrapped phase, and wrapped phase measurements from InSAR processing.

az.title: Azimuth Offset
az.description: Azimuth offset measurements detecting horizontal ground displacement perpendicular to satellite flight direction from InSAR processing.

rng.title: Range Offset
rng.description: Range offset measurements detecting ground displacement parallel to satellite line-of-sight from InSAR processing.

unw.title: Unwrapped Phase
unw.description: Unwrapped interferometric phase representing ground displacement measurements after phase ambiguity resolution.

wrp.title: Wrapped Phase
wrp.description: Wrapped interferometric phase showing ground displacement within 2π phase cycles before unwrapping.
